sections.title: About Me
sections.subtitle: Where Formal Mathematical Reasoning Meets Modern Web Development
sections.summary: An intellectual and professional overview balancing postgraduate mathematics, software craftsmanship, analytical thinking, creativity, and organizational leadership.

content.leadParagraph: Mathematics postgraduate skilled in analytical modeling and problem-solving, with practical experience in web development using JavaScript and React.js. Strong at applying mathematical thinking to research and building efficient digital solutions.
paragraphs: My academic journey at the University of Chittagong—completing both a Bachelor of Science (Honours) and a Master of Science in Mathematics—shaped how I approach complex problems. Whether formulating an optimal control model or structuring state flow in a modern web application, I rely on clarity, precision, and foundational reasoning.

Professionally, I work as a Developer at Nerobytes in Chattogram, Bangladesh, translating user and business requirements into responsive web experiences with JavaScript and React.js. Beyond equations and code, I value balanced personal growth: serving as General Secretary of the Jalalabad Student’s Association strengthened my communication and teamwork, while sketching by reference keeps my visual observation sharp.
